gameName: Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective: The Thames Murders & Other Cases
firstPlayerRule: Choose a lead investigator. That player reads the case introduction, then chooses the first lead to investigate. The role passes left after each turn.
clarifications: Everyone cooperates and may discuss the next lead. If the group disagrees about where to go, the current lead investigator decides.
Read one lead aloud and record that it has been followed, then pass the booklet left. If a location has no entry in this case, choose another lead.
Choose a case together; the rules suggest chronological order to avoid newspaper spoilers. Use its dated newspaper and earlier issues, leaving later newspapers aside.
Keep the London map, directory and informant list available to the group.

internalEvidence: Codex rechecked the publisher's current English product page, https://www.spacecowboys-games.com/game/the-thames-murders/, on 2026-10-15. Its The Thames Murders Rule English link still resolves to the cited SHJR_Rules_C1_EN_BD.pdf. The downloaded PDF has SHA-256 c2198ad34225905c7e0d658f36b8e3ab52c34c988ae856962b9e125a669995bb, matching the 2026-09-26 reviewed source. Source custody: research/source-files/indexing-oct15/sherlock-thames.pdf. Codex visually read the complete rendered PDF page 8, printed page 6, and checked the extracted booklet text and 2016 Space Cowboys credits. Game setup chooses a case and lead investigator; chronological case order is recommended to avoid spoilers, and only the case-date and earlier newspapers are used. Game overview specifies cooperative discussion, one lead per turn, leftward booklet/role rotation, another choice if a location has no entry, and the current lead investigator's final say on a disputed destination. Public text paraphrases this setup without case solutions. This is the Thames Murders box, not Jack the Ripper or another standalone set. No criterion creates a player-selection tie; generic tie and picker advice are suppressed. Owner authorized the factual improvements and deployment on 2026-10-15. Existing image source/fair-use review is retained, not represented as newly reviewed. Random mix: excluded because this is a game-specific cooperative role.
